metadata.remarks: Security Monitoring defines the capability to continuously analyze security telemetry, correlate events across domains, establish behavioral baselines, and generate actionable alerts. Control implementation is expressed at the capability level to support operational traceability.

components.title: Event Correlation and Analysis
components.description: Correlation and analysis of security telemetry across multiple sources.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security events are correlated and analyzed to identify potential incidents.
Audit records are reviewed and analyzed for indications of suspicious activity.

components.title: Baseline and Anomaly Detection
components.description: Establishment of expected behavior baselines and detection of deviations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuous monitoring activities identify deviations from expected operational behavior.

components.title: Alerting and Visibility
components.description: Generation of alerts, notifications, and dashboards for security operations.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Security-relevant events generate alerts and visualizations for timely operator awareness.
